In its World Energy Outlook released this week, the International Energy Agency once again joined the growing chorus of forecasters warning that data centers are becoming a major drain on electricity supply. analysis.summary: IEA warns AI and data centers are driving >10,000 TWh in electricity demand growth over the next decade, requiring major power grid upgrades.

news.title: Lufthansa to Slash 1,000 Jobs as Airlines Reel from High Fuel Costs

analysis.rationale: The text highlights elevated crude and jet fuel prices from Middle East conflict (bullish backdrop) alongside airline capacity reductions that curb future jet fuel demand (bearish demand response).

news.title: Norway’s Gas Sales Surge Nearly 20% as Europe Braces for Winter
news.summary: Norway’s daily gas sales jumped nearly 20% in October and were 5.6% above year-earlier levels. The rebound comes as the EU heads into winter with its gas storage facilities less than 70% full. Norway sold 11 billion cubic meters of natural gas in October, up 2.1 billion cubic meters from September, according to preliminary figures from the Norwegian Offshore Directorate. Daily sales averaged 355.6 million cubic meters, up from a revised 296.8 million in September and 2.2% above the regulator’s forecast. EU gas storage was 69.8% full…

analysis.summary: Norway's October daily gas sales rose nearly 20% month-on-month as the EU enters winter with gas storage below 70%.
analysis.rationale: The item concerns European natural gas supply and storage balances; higher Norwegian gas output offsets tight storage, leaving no clear directional signal for crude oil.

news.title: U.S. Energy Exports Hit Records as Global Competition Intensifies
news.summary: Rising U.S. oil and gas production and export capacity, along with a shift in global energy trade flows from the war in Iran, helped the United States hit record highs in crude, fuels, and LNG exports this year. In the decade since 2016, when LNG exports began, and crude oil shipments were allowed to go not only in Canada, U.S. energy exports have soared to make America one of the major crude oil exporters and the world’s biggest exporter of LNG, propane, and ethane. Over the past decade, the U.S. toppled Qatar and Australia…

analysis.summary: Record U.S. crude, fuel, and LNG exports driven by rising production and export capacity alongside Iran-war trade shifts.
analysis.rationale: Rising U.S. production and record exports increase global supply competition (bearish), while trade flow disruptions from the war in Iran imply geopolitical supply risk (bullish).

GasBuddy expects prices to average $3.62 on Thanksgiving Day, which would surpass the previous holiday record of $3.56 set in 2022. The declines are substantial. analysis.summary: U.S. retail gasoline prices fell nearly 60 cents over a month as crude oil retreated and supplies recovered, despite high holiday comparisons.
